subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope-field leaks be fixed with a narrow shared/Discord outbound sanitizer now, or folded into the broader explicit-send/output policy work?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the boundary can suppress legitimate JSON or markdown and intersects active security/product policy about what assistant text should be user-visible.

options.title: Ship Narrow Sanitizer With Proof
options.body: Cover the listed envelope-field variants in the shared or Discord delivery boundary, add false-positive regression tests, and require a redacted live Discord proof before closing.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Policy
options.body: Move the checklist into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/25592 and keep this issue open only until that tracker explicitly owns these Discord variants.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro First
options.body: Hold implementation until maintainers reproduce the remaining variants in a current live Discord setup.

recommendation.title: Ship Narrow Sanitizer With Proof
recommendation.body: Cover the listed envelope-field variants in the shared or Discord delivery boundary, add false-positive regression tests, and require a redacted live Discord proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated work on the Discord delivery and shared outbound boundaries that frame this product/security choice.
